Dear Madam
I am much obliged in the name of the [Melanesian Mission](/organisation/30) for your subscription, but I am afraid I must ask you to exchange it for one on Winchester as there is no money order office here and they will not cash it at Winchester

Yours truly
Charlotte Yonge
